feature: D3 Layer 1 experiment — symptom-first prompt (H1) + changed-line evidence forcing (H4) + mechanism evaluator loop (T3)
problem: D3=0.230 at V1 n=50. 91% of D3=0 failures are wrong-mechanism: agent cites correct files but wrong causal chain. Root cause: abstraction bias (LLM applies familiar code pattern template instead of reasoning from changed lines). The fix: (1) restructure prompt to reason from observable symptom first; (2) require +/- changed line citation in evidence; (3) loop to challenge context-only citations.
proposed_solution: Add HYPOTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT_H1H4T3 to hypothesis_engine.py: (H1) mechanism field starts from user-observable failure before code structure; (H4) evidence_quote must cite at least one +/- prefixed changed line for primary mechanism. Add mechanism_evaluator_loop() in hypothesis_engine.py: after first LLM call, check if primary hypotheses cite +/- lines; if not, send targeted challenge and re-run (max 1 challenge re-run after initial call, deterministic criterion — no LLM in evaluator). Add enable_mechanism_evaluator: bool flag to AgentOrchestrator. Add experiment script scripts/run_d3_experiment_layer1.py to run hard panel n=18 with baseline vs H1H4T3 variant and report D3 delta.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: hypothesis_engine.py exports HYPOTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT_H1H4T3 — a distinct variant (not byte-identical to HYPOTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT) that retains extract_coverage_section(HYPOTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT_H1H4T3) non-empty and includes all of: substring 'Observable:', substring 'Root change:', a '## CHANGED-LINE EVIDENCE' section stating primary mechanism evidence_quote must contain at least one line starting with + or - (actual code change, not context), and mechanism field instruction requiring format 'Observable: [user-visible failure]. Root change: [+/- line]. Mechanism: [causal chain at file:area]'.

AC-2: hypothesis_engine.py exports _has_changed_line_citation(evidence_quote: str) -> bool that returns True iff evidence_quote contains at least one non-empty line (after strip) whose first non-whitespace character starts a changed-line prefix: line matches ^\s*[+-] but NOT ^\s*\+\+\+ and NOT ^\s*--- (diff file headers). Unit tested with named cases: empty string→False, whitespace-only→False, context-only quote (no +/- prefixed lines)→False, quote containing '+added line'→True, quote containing '-removed line'→True, quote containing only '+++ b/file' and '--- a/file'→False.

AC-3: hypothesis_engine.py exports mechanism_evaluator_loop() wrapping complete_with_parse_retry: after each LLM response, inspect hypotheses[:3]; if any hypothesis has evidence_quote.strip() non-empty and _has_changed_line_citation(evidence_quote) is False, append a user-role challenge message that names the offending mechanism field text and explicitly requires citing a +/- changed diff line, then re-run (at most 1 challenge re-run after the initial call — 2 LLM invocations total maximum). Return immediately when all inspected hypotheses have empty/whitespace evidence_quote OR all non-empty quotes pass _has_changed_line_citation. Evaluator uses only _has_changed_line_citation — no LLM judge.

AC-4: AgentOrchestrator.__init__ accepts enable_mechanism_evaluator: bool = False (default preserved). When False: investigate() calls complete_with_parse_retry with build_investigation_messages(context) using default HYPOTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT — identical code path to current. When True: investigate() calls mechanism_evaluator_loop() with build_investigation_messages(context, system_prompt=HYPOTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT_H1H4T3). Unit test with mock LLM: flag=False must never invoke mechanism_evaluator_loop; flag=True must invoke mechanism_evaluator_loop exactly once per investigate() and pass HYPOTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT_H1H4T3 as system prompt.

AC-5: scripts/run_d3_experiment_layer1.py loads the 18-commit hard panel as sorted union of tier_1_d3_zero + tier_2_d3_partial from .harness/evals/v2-forensics-n50.json hard_commit_panel (authoritative; do not rely on state.json tier2 which may be empty). Runs baseline (enable_mechanism_evaluator=False) and h1h4t3 (True) variants. Outputs stdout table with header row and exactly 18 data rows: commit_prefix | baseline_D3 | h1h4t3_D3 | delta (delta = h1h4t3_D3 - baseline_D3). Prints aggregate line with n_improved (delta>0), n_regressed (delta<0), mean_delta_D3 (mean of deltas). --dry-run: no LLM calls; prints table with all 18 commit prefixes and placeholder or cached D3 scores; exit 0.

AC-6: pytest tests/ -q exits 0. Minimum 7 new test cases: ≥5 for _has_changed_line_citation covering AC-2 named cases; ≥2 for mechanism_evaluator_loop (immediate return when all quotes empty/grounded; exhausted loop returns after exactly 2 mock LLM calls when mock always returns context-only quotes).
edge_cases: EC-1: All primary hypotheses (hypotheses[:3]) have empty or whitespace-only evidence_quote — evaluator does NOT challenge and returns after the first LLM call. Test must assert mock LLM call count == 1.
EC-2: Model returns context-only evidence_quote on both attempts — evaluator returns round-2 response without a third LLM call. Test must assert mock LLM call count == 2 exactly.

EC-3: enable_mechanism_evaluator=False — mechanism_evaluator_loop is never called; HYPOTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT_H1H4T3 is never passed to build_investigation_messages. Existing orchestrator tests pass unchanged; new patch-based test required per AC-4.

EC-4: Diff header lines ('+++ b/file', '--- a/file', with optional leading whitespace) must NOT count as changed-line citations — _has_changed_line_citation returns False for quotes containing only these lines (covered by AC-2 unit tests).
verification_method: (1) pytest tests/ -q — exit 0, ≥7 new test cases pass per AC-6; (2) python -c "from commit_investigator.hypothesis_engine import HYPOTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT_H1H4T3, _has_changed_line_citation, mechanism_evaluator_loop, extract_coverage_section; assert extract_coverage_section(HYPOTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT_H1H4T3); assert 'Observable:' in HYPOTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT_H1H4T3; print('imports OK')"; (3) python -c "import inspect; from commit_investigator.orchestrator import AgentOrchestrator; p=inspect.signature(AgentOrchestrator.__init__).parameters; assert p['enable_mechanism_evaluator'].default is False; AgentOrchestrator(enable_mechanism_evaluator=True); print('flag OK')"; (4) python scripts/run_d3_experiment_layer1.py --dry-run — exit 0; stdout contains table header and all 18 commit prefixes from .harness/evals/v2-forensics-n50.json hard_commit_panel union (exactly 18 data rows).

negotiation_notes.AC-3: STRENGTHENED: clarified 2 LLM calls max (initial + 1 challenge), challenge message content requirement, hypotheses[:3] scope, strip() for empty detection.
negotiation_notes.AC-4: STRENGTHENED: patch-based regression test — flag=False never calls mechanism_evaluator_loop; flag=True calls it with H1H4T3 prompt.
negotiation_notes.AC-5: STRENGTHENED: hard panel source switched to v2-forensics-n50.json (state.json tier2 empty); require exactly 18 rows; define delta formula.
negotiation_notes.AC-6: STRENGTHENED: raised minimum to 7 tests with explicit breakdown and LLM call-count assertions.
negotiation_notes.EC-1: STRENGTHENED: whitespace-only treated as empty; assert call_count==1.
negotiation_notes.EC-2: STRENGTHENED: assert call_count==2 exactly on exhausted loop.
negotiation_notes.EC-3: STRENGTHENED: requires new patch test, not just 'existing suite passes'.
